item.title: Big D & Bubba
item.description: Big D & Bubba 5A-10A M-F 6A-10A SAT Country 103.1 KKCY welcomes Big D & Bubba to mornings Mon-Fri 5A-10A, and Saturdays 6A-10A The show steps in following the conclusion of the Dave & Briggs Show which had it’s last episode on Feb 28. Big D & Bubba are newly elected to the Country Music Radio Hall of Fame, and are the official country morning show for the Armed Forces Radio Network.
